'''''Black Box''''' was a [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

When the Rebels realized that [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] built by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]] were [[Battle of the Eva-T system|intercepted]] by then [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in his [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Grey Wolf]], they sent a group of 3 [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] to fight him. The ships underestimate his new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Missile Boat]] piloted by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and as it was becoming evident they were losing, the '''Black Box''' was launched and attempted to escape the battle. The shuttle was inspected by Maarek Stele and destroyed before it could flee.
